2.260.18
MapLegend.Style
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapLegend.Style element specifies style information for a MapLegend. This element is optional
and is of type Style.
Following is the parent element of the MapLegend.Style element.
Parent elements
MapLegend
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapLegend.Style element.
 <xsd:element name="Style" type="StyleType" minOccurs="0" />
